source: vanilla 26.2 official defaults and catalog encodings after tag bind + component bind
notExhaustive: Full official set of item default component encodings, recipe JSON codec+streamCodec/display, and sound event ids. Numeric values inside components are the official defaults, not a sweep of all ints/floats.
itemDefaultEncoding: official streamCodec of item prototype values after tag-first synchronized FrozenAccess bind; the encode RegistryAccess is the same instance used to bind DATA_COMPONENT_INITIALIZERS. Independent official wire, not item-default-report JSON reparse.
soundCodecNote: All sound events share ClientboundSoundPacket / SoundEvent holder encodings already proven (registry holder, inline variable-range, inline fixed-range). This table is the official static id set; live playback of every event is not required.
